events.verdict: Whiteside (MIA) establishes himself in Snell's (MIL) path and then legally rolls into the lane.
Wilson (MIL) makes marginal lower body contact with Wade (MIA) after the release of his jump shot attempt and does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
Winslow (MIA) makes marginal contact with Wilson (MIL) during rebounding before the putback attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) makes marginal contact with Whiteside's (MIA) left forearm during the rebound that does not affect his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Whiteside (MIA) slides his pivot foot after gathering the rebound.
Bledsoe (MIL) places his hand against Richardson's (MIA) inside hip and makes marginal contact.
Whiteside (MIA) sets the pick in Bledsoe's (MIL) path and is firming up over his leg when contact occurs.
RLS shows Bledsoe (MIL) makes contact with Richardson's (MIA) right forearm prior to the release of his jump shot attempt.
Wade (MIA) reaches in and makes marginal contact with Middleton's (MIL) left forearm after his gather.
Whiteside (MIA) sets the pick on Snell (MIL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Wade (MIA) ends his dribble and hops on the same foot before the shot attempt.
Johnson (MIA) cleanly blocks Middleton's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Wade (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball as he and Wilson (MIL) attempt to retrieve it during the rebound.
Richardson (MIA) gathers the ball and takes two legal steps thereafter.
Snell (MIL) makes incidental contact with Whiteside (MIA) during rebounding.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) commits the take foul on Wade (MIA) in the backcourt.
LLB shows Wade (MIA) makes marginal contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm during the shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) commits the take foul on Richardson (MIA) after the inbound.
Richardson (MIA) reaches in and makes contact across Bledsoe's (MIL) front during the drive.
Wade (MIA) briefly grasps Middleton's (MIL) jersey during the inbound, but releases without affecting his FOM or ability to defend.
